sources.title: Dashlane personal plans comparison (Family plan price), independent of official page which did not display amounts in this session

keyLimits.en: Shared subscription for up to 10 members; plan administrator gets full premium features, other members get everything except VPN.
Secure vault, unlimited collections, AI-powered autofill, secure credential sharing, password health dashboard, admin vault policies, SSO & SCIM. 14-day free trial available.
Credential risk and AI phishing detection, risk dashboards and alerts, SIEM/SOAR and IGA tool integration.
Custom pricing with volume optimization and dedicated account management.

cautions.en: Business plan prices are not published on the official pricing page; amounts require contacting sales, so exact per-seat business rates could not be verified in this session.

The official personal-plan pricing page (dashlane.com/personal/pricing) returned a 404 during this session; the Friends & Family price of $7.49/mo comes from a Dashlane support article rather than the primary pricing page and should be re-verified.

capabilities.en: Password vault with AI-powered autofill and password generator.
Secure credential sharing and password health dashboard.
Credential risk and AI phishing detection with remediation dashboards (Business Credential Protection tier).
SSO and SCIM integrations for business accounts.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; only a 14-day free trial is offered for business password management.
Business pricing is not public, requiring a sales conversation to get a quote.

reason.en: Direct commercial competitor in the consumer and business password manager space.
Open-source password manager alternative with a free tier.
Another subscription password manager targeting individuals and small teams.
Adjacent secrets management tool for developer teams, sometimes compared for credential handling.

unknowns: Exact per-seat prices for Dashlane Business Password Management, Credential Protection and Enterprise plans are not public and were not disclosed on the pricing page.
Individual Premium plan price (non-family) could not be confirmed directly on dashlane.com in this session (personal pricing URL returned 404).
